d: Google has confirmed that around 30 roles were eliminated at Google Cloud India last week, describing the cuts as a small organisational change. The clarification comes after employee posts on Blind sparked speculation about wider layoffs, possible exit programmes and a hiring slowdown in India. Claims of a larger layoff exercise and a 2027 hiring freeze involving Google and Microsoft remain unconfirmed, with neither company announcing a recruitment freeze in India. As tech companies redirect resources towards AI, concerns are growing over job security and campus hiring opportunities.
